title: The body of an array comprehension has no region
summary: The body of an array comprehension has no region of its own, so what it allocates on the local stack stays until the function returns: 24 bytes for each element here, where the same body in a `for` loop uses 24 bytes in all. Under `ulimit -v 200000` a comprehension of 4,000,000 elements ends with `Local allocation stack overflow`.

actual.text: Prints `Fatal error: Local allocation stack overflow - out of memory`; exit status 134.

cause: `lambda/transl_array_comprehension.ml` builds its `Lfor` with the body as it is, where `translcore` wraps the body of a source loop in a region.
